lead_text:
Dear Generali Team,
I would like to request a quotation for comprehensive private health insurance for two adults, currently residing in Voula, Greece.
We are interested in your Life On Premium / Medical Prime plan, or the closest comparable comprehensive medical insurance plan available.
Could you please provide details regarding:

* Hospitalisation and inpatient coverage
* Outpatient consultations and specialist visits
* Diagnostic tests and examinations
* Emergency treatment and day surgery
* Direct billing with private hospitals in Greece
* International / overseas medical coverage
* Annual health check-ups and preventive care
* Prescription medication coverage
* Annual premium
* Deductible options
* Coverage limits
* Waiting periods
* Treatment of pre-existing conditions
* Renewal terms and age limits
* Medical underwriting requirements
* Earliest possible policy start date

Please let us know what information or documents you require in order to prepare the quotation.
Kind regards
reply_draft:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry and for considering Generali as your health insurance provider. Generali is a well-known insurer in Greece, distinguished for its hospital cover and the range of benefits it offers.

You sent a detailed list of questions, and I cover each of them in this reply or in the quotation.

To be fully transparent about your requirements: Generali's programmes cover hospitalisation in Greece very well, but doctors, tests and emergency visits are covered only within their partner network. Routine visits to private doctors and specialists of your own choice are not included. In more detail, on a recent Generali quotation:

* Hospital stays in Greece covered at 100% with no participation, up to €300,000 a year per person, in Generali's partner hospitals: Hygeia and Mitera (Hygeia Group) in Athens and Euromedica in Thessaloniki. A first-class room adds €100 a night. [CONFIRM: these figures come from a recent quote for one adult and may differ on your family quote; the quote shows no participation 'with use of a social insurance fund', so check how it applies if you do not use one]
* Unlimited scheduled visits to partner doctors, €10 per visit.
* Emergencies: a visit to a partner doctor on duty has no participation; a partner specialist called out in an emergency costs €50.
* Diagnostic tests and medical procedures: up to €1,500 per insurance year, with 15% participation, on referral from a partner doctor.
* Physiotherapy: up to €1,000 per insurance year, with 15% participation.
* Annual preventive check-up (14 tests for adults, 5 for children), €10 each, available from six months after the start.

Waiting periods: doctors and tests are covered from one month after the start. For hospital cover, conditions you declare and already know about are covered after two years (five years if they relate to a malignancy); conditions that were unknown and undeclared after one or two years, depending on the condition; and congenital conditions (other than cardiac) and listed special conditions after ten years.

Since you are looking for outpatient cover for doctors, specialists and tests and cover and direct billing abroad, we would recommend an international private medical insurance (IPMI) plan, and for this reason your enquiry has been passed to me.

At Ashlar we work with Generali in the Greek market, and we also have direct agreements with many IPMI providers, including VUMI, Bupa, Cigna, Allianz Care, IMG, APRIL International, OneHealth, Now Health and Morgan Price, so we can compare both routes for you. We are paid only by commission from the insurer you choose, and we do not charge you any fee.

IPMI plans can combine:

* Outpatient cover for doctors, specialists, diagnostics and prescriptions, with emergency care including visits where admission is not required
* Cover and direct billing outside Greece, in Europe or worldwide

If these are not a high priority, we can instead provide a Generali hospital cover quotation alongside the IPMI one, so you can compare both and decide what suits you best. Generali requires a valid Greek AFM for each adult.

Prescription medication is not covered under the doctors and tests cover; chronic-condition medication is available only through a separate add-on. Preventive check-ups are limited to the tests listed in the quotation. [CONFIRM: preventive exams are excluded from the Doctors & Exams Premium add-on] Hospital stays abroad are covered at 100% (90% in the USA and Canada) on the quotation I have; outpatient care abroad is not part of the programme. [CONFIRM against the wording]

For the Generali option I will send the exclusions and how pre-existing conditions are treated as the policy wording states them. I will confirm direct billing, the annual premium, the medical underwriting requirements, renewal terms and age limits and the earliest possible start date with Generali.

For the international options we will also provide the participating hospital list, direct-billing arrangements, reimbursement for out-of-network doctors, waiting periods, exclusions, annual limits, deductible options, the annual premium, how pre-existing conditions are treated, the medical underwriting requirements, renewal terms and age limits, the earliest possible start date, prescription cover, check-up and preventive cover and overseas cover.

I will also check the policy wording on: pre-existing conditions.

To prepare your quotation, please send us:
1. Dates of birth and nationalities of everyone to be insured
2. Whether each adult holds a valid Greek AFM (Generali requires one)
3. Any existing conditions or ongoing treatment
4. Hospitals or doctors you would like to keep using
5. Whether you want cover in Greece only, Europe, or worldwide
6. Any extras you want, such as maternity, dental, or check-ups
7. Your approximate annual budget
8. Your preferred start date

Best regards,
